cases.name: Debra Lynn Childers
cases.narrative: On 5/28/2021, investigators searched two storage units that belonged to Childers and found her body inside a large duffle bag, where she had been for months. Police said that Puett met Childers last summer while both were living out of their vehicles, and Childers was killed sometime in November when the two were sharing a room at a motel in Kingman.
